First TBM reaches Pune; Swargate–Katraj tunnelling to start in January

Tunnelling for the underground Metro extension from Swargate to Katraj is expected to start in January, when the first of four tunnel boring machines (TBMs) reaches the launch shaft.

Tunnelling will be done from both ends at the same time, with two TBMs working from Swargate and two from Katraj.

The machines will work about 28 metres below ground level.

Preparatory work is already on. Excavation of the shaft at Market Yard station has begun.
